hero_subtitle: Specialist in uniting technology and data to build scalable AI solutions and immersive gaming experiences.
about_text_1: I began my journey as a 3D Level Designer at a game development startup at the age of 17, where I quickly expanded into various creative and technical roles—ranging from texture design to programming mechanics for third-person games. That same year, I enrolled in Computer Science at the State University of Maringá (UEM), allowing me to deepen my passion for technology through core pillars such as Theory of Computation, Algorithm Complexity Analysis, Networking, Cryptography, and Artificial Intelligence.
about_text_2: Currently, I focus my expertise on high-performance Web Development, merging this rigorous academic foundation with the creation of modern, scalable solutions. Additionally, I take an active role in integrating AI into workflows and products, leveraging advanced models and Machine Learning algorithms to solve complex problems and optimize user experience. My career reflects a continuous transition between classical software engineering and the emerging technologies shaping the future.
exp1_text: Focus on Backend (FastAPI, Flask) and Artificial Intelligence (Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Time Series) using TensorFlow and PyTorch.
exp2_text: End-to-end development with React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, and Tailwind CSS.
exp3_text: Creation of 3D mechanics in C++ and Blueprints, multiplayer systems, and high-precision physics simulators.
exp4_text: Implementation of network systems and technical art (Blender, Substance Painter) for Desktop, Consoles, and Mobile.
